description.tr: Kesin Kur'an tefsirini VE 40 ciltlik dünya tarihini yazdı — 40 yıl boyunca günde 40 sayfa ürettiği rivayet edilir || Taberî'nin entelektüel dürüstlüğü dikkat çekiciydi — çelişkili rivayetleri editoryal yargı olmadan dahil etti. || [Tarih notu] SUNY'nin 40 ciltlik İngilizce çevirisi Taberî'nin vazgeçilmezliğini doğruladı.
description.en: Wrote the definitive Quran commentary AND a 40-volume world history — reportedly producing 40 pages per day for 40 years. His intellectual honesty set the standard for Islamic scholarship || Tabari's intellectual honesty was remarkable — he included contradictory accounts without editorial judgment, letting sources speak for themselves. His tafsir remains the standard reference for all subsequent Quran commentaries. Hugh Kennedy calls his history 'one of the great monuments of world history.' || [Historiographical note] SUNY's 40-volume English translation (completed after 20+ years) confirmed Tabari's indispensability. His citation of the 'Satanic Verses' incident became central to the Salman Rushdie controversy.
description.ar: كتب التفسير الأشمل للقرآن وتاريخًا عالميًا في ٤٠ مجلدًا || أمانة الطبري الفكرية مميزة — أدرج روايات متناقضة دون حكم. تفسيره لا يزال المرجع المعياري. يصفه هيو كينيدي بأنه 'من الآثار العظيمة للتاريخ العالمي'
